app.name: Sprout
app.tagline: A private place to keep your child's growing-up story.

landing.title: Every step, every first, kept safe.
landing.subtitle: Collect photos, videos, milestones and notes about your child in one timeline. Share with family — or with no one at all. You decide, post by post.

features.timelineBody: Moments ordered by date and age, from first steps to graduation.
features.projectsBody: Follow a skill over time — piano, swimming, a science fair.
features.privacyBody: Only you and the family you invite can see anything until you choose to share.

landing.accountDeleted: Your account has been deleted. Thank you for using Sprout.
